title: Find a hardcoded value and patch it live
summary: Analyse the executable with Ghidra, find the code behind a value the program shows or logs, change it live in x64dbg, then keep the change as a patch set. Needs the analysis and capture switches.

inputs.name: target
inputs.label: Target key (ANALYSIS, LIST TARGETS names them, e.g. game-exe)

steps.title: Analyse the executable (Ghidra headless, a copy)
Find the code in Ghidra
steps.text: In ANALYSIS, CONTINUE IN GHIDRA on the same target, then find the string or constant and the instruction that compares or loads the value. Note its offset (address minus image base).

steps.title: Change it live in x64dbg
steps.text: In RUNTIME, DEBUGGER AND MEMORY: CONTINUE IN X64DBG on the same executable (it attaches when the game runs). Go to the offset, assemble the new instruction, run, and check the effect.

steps.title: Keep it as a patch set
steps.text: Write the change as a ViWo patch set (an AOB address finds it again after an update) and apply it into a patched copy: PATCHING, PATCHES + MODS, or the runbook 'Apply a patch set into a patched copy'.
